title: Supermarket Tycoon
description: Build and expand a bustling mini-supermarket empire—stock fresh shelves, ring up eager customers, hire helpers, and watch profits pile sky-high.
controls: Tap and drag to manage departments, restock goods, unlock new aisles, and collect cash earnings.

zh-CN.title: 超市大亨
zh-CN.description: 超上头模拟经营超市大亨：补满生鲜货架、加快收银结账、招募店员扩建卖场，从街头小店一路干成亿万连锁商超！
zh-CN.controls: 点击升级货架、收银台与店员效率，收集营业额不断解锁新商品区扩大超市规模。
